title: Bicycle Attacks Considered Harmful: Quantifying the Damage of Widespread Password Length Leakage
reasoning: The paper is a technical security analysis of password length leakage. It uses a decision-theoretic model of a 'rational' attacker, which is a standard approach in security economics, not an evaluation of ethics. The mention of an ethics board review is procedural and does not constitute a core research component focused on evaluating ethics or morals.
